CoreRulesetFields.name: Name
CoreRulesetFields.engineHint: CRS version, how strict the rules are and when a request is blocked.
CoreRulesetFields.paranoiaHint: Higher levels enable more rules and produce more false positives.
CoreRulesetFields.detectionParanoiaHint: Rules up to this level are logged without counting toward blocking.
CoreRulesetFields.earlyBlockingHint: Block as soon as the threshold is reached instead of at the end of the phase.
CoreRulesetFields.ruleGroupsHint: Attack classes inspected by this ruleset.
CoreRulesetFields.requestHint: What the engine reads from a request and which requests it accepts.
CoreRulesetFields.bodyAccessHint: Required for the rules that match on body parameters.
CoreRulesetFields.allowedMethodsHint: Leave empty to use the CRS default.
CoreRulesetFields.allowedContentTypesHint: Separated by commas or spaces; empty uses the CRS default.
CoreRulesetFields.exclusionsHint: Remove false positives by tag, or by taking a variable out of a rule.
CoreRulesetFields.tagsHint: Every rule carrying one of these tags is removed.
CoreRulesetFields.overridesHint: Change the state of a single CRS rule.
CoreRulesetFields.scopedHint: Applies to every request unless a condition is set. Body, JA4 and TLS sources are not supported.
CoreRulesetFields.pickerDescription: Search the rules of the selected CRS version.
CoreRulesetFields.pickerSearch: Search by message, tag or ID...
CoreRulesetFields.pickerFailed: Failed to load the CRS rule catalog
CoreRulesetFields.tagPickerDescription: Pick the tags of the selected CRS version to exclude.

statusDescription.active: The rule is evaluated against incoming requests.
statusDescription.disable: The rule is kept but skipped during evaluation.

priorityDescription.low: Evaluated last, after all other rules.

actionTypeDescription.block: Reject the request when the condition matches.
actionTypeDescription.log: Allow the request and record a log entry.
actionTypeDescription.modifyHeader: Set a request header (name and value) when matched.
actionTypeDescription.redirect: Redirect the client to the given URL.
actionTypeDescription.setTag: Attach a tag to the request for downstream use.
actionTypeDescription.routeTo: Route the request to the given upstream/target.

engineModeDescription.on: Requests over the anomaly threshold are blocked.
engineModeDescription.detectionOnly: Matches are logged, requests are never blocked.
engineModeDescription.off: The Core Rule Set is not evaluated.

crsVersion.latestDescription: Follows the newest version the edge supports.

ruleStateDescription.detectionOnly: The rule is logged but does not count toward blocking.
ruleStateDescription.enabled: The rule is forced on, even above the paranoia level.
